edits.beforeRaw:
This is a source-only proposal for two finite native programmes against committed root feb36c0c. It preserves the original six successful constructor-lock receipts and the original 92-object schema history. Neither positive programme has run. Root alone may execute after independent peer review and committing the exact SETUP_ENTRY.md append.

`CONTACT_CONSTRUCTORS_V1` renders both complete original constructor bodies, including the real prerequisite lock order and retained-history assertions. The source contains 21 statements/13,974 bytes; the bounded native input adds genuine turn/clock/marker/observation frames for 34 statements. No constructor predicate, retained row or dynamic identifier guard is substituted. The input can truthfully fail on actual prerequisite drift or unresolved retained identity.

`QT_ADMIN_CONTROLS_V1` renders the exact QT schema, seven current QT owners and three closed Health primitive/Admin helpers, then exercises native Admin get/save, unchanged and changed saves, same-request and historical replay, changed-body and stale-CAS refusal, ten ordinary/pay-only/inactive GET/SAVE denials, two same-transaction role-loss replay refusals, exact two immutable command receipts, effective role ACLs and the genuine Golden store invariant. It uses the unchanged actor R2 native store/touch preflight and the same six vacant fixture users; no login or original user is modified. The source contains 51 statements/39,738 bytes; the input contains 64 statements. Exact rendered sizes/hashes and expected assertion frames are sealed in PROGRAMMES.json. Expected output is not an observed native verdict.

The local policy fixture proves this agency TEST store's actual control functions. It does not qualify browser deployment binding, real API roles, a second agency, concurrent revocation or post-wait freshness. Those scopes remain NOT_RUN. Both settings stores and the global audit table are preserved. QT's audit is the existing immutable command journal; no extra audit row is invented. The schema-cache NOTIFY already in the genuine QT owner stays inside rollback B and is not committed. No provider, email, dispatch, scheduler, payment or Banking-owned body is read or called by these programmes.

The fixed C reader retains the seven-hunk actor-reader successor plus the separately reversed closed SQLSTATE diagnostic forward. Only one complete anchored ERROR/FATAL SQLSTATE frame may yield its five uppercase/digit characters; unsupported stderr and NOTICE remain generic refusals. Actual phase/start/spawn-return/first-stderr/finish times accompany any branded fixed-child failure. No raw diagnostic, SQL, query/body, map, server message or guessed cause is saved. The complete raw parent inverse retains both reader stages. The bounded transport, original canonical exporter, full catalogue/ledger/relation census, original four background writer authorities, both complete background maps, distinct fresh C-after fixture proof and original WeakMap qualifier are retained. The finite relation scope adds all six original Contact witnesses, real users, both settings stores and audit_events: twelve complete relation scopes. Before any business heap read in C, and before marker/DDL in B, a catalogue-only guard binds the exact physical owner, heap/RLS identities and single literal true service-owner policy for all twelve scopes, refuses rules/inheritance and requires no enabled DDL event hook. Native differences require a separate exact effect review; no callback is assumed read-only or waived. There is no arbitrary SQL interface, generic provider or fake Contact case alias. Control and timing modules are byte-identical to their reviewed parent, including the existing 120-second work/180-second whole-sequence budget, explicit deadline cause, child close/termination bounds and 64 MiB fixed metadata cap. Some internal inherited error names retain ACTOR; that label confers no authority.

Root-owned entry is `node hold-case.mjs <actual I2 D path> <fresh I2 .codex-tmp/contact-qt-positive-native-20261017-... directory> <exact case ID> --authorised-root-holder`. This connects; do not invoke during source review. Source guards require physical I2/repository/common Git on D, exact pinned source bytes and saved/index/HEAD adapter equality, the committed setup entry, TEST/LEGACY:1/no APPLYING, current shared-turn ownership and a real marker created in B and absent fresh. The server-owned MCP envelope retains 8,000,000 SQL bytes/1,000 statements, 30-second per-statement timeout, 2-second lock timeout and one returned row per SELECT. No cap is increased.

Use one root orchestration for execution: start the reviewed holder, wait READY, read its small INPUT.json silently, record actual `new Date().toISOString()` immediately before and after the awaited exact Kier rollback call, save server structuredContent unchanged as NATIVE_RESULT.json, save NATIVE_CALL_TIMING.json, then send PREPARE. After independent C-after qualification, send RELEASE. Timing JSON is exactly `{version:'ROOT_OBSERVED_MCP_CALL_TIMING_V1',route:<exact ROUTE>,sqlSha256:<receipt SQL hash>,callStartedAt:<actual ISO>,callReturnedAt:<actual ISO>}`. These are root clock observations, not server latency or accepted-result fields. Keep full maps in process memory only. Reconcile any dispatched B after HOLD; the journal alone records actual own unlock/close.

`node test.mjs` checks finite source/render/transport/result boundaries with explicitly synthetic protocol fixtures, never a native result. `python grammar-and-bindings.py` parses the complete rendered PostgreSQL 17 inputs and checks PL-record names against parsed SQL range aliases, including the genuine R1 record-p/pg_proc-p failure counterexample. Grammar and source alias checks do not prove native compilation, semantic SQL binding or successful execution. All actual native acceptance/restoration remains NOT_RUN.

The reviewed statement-snapshot CSE successor against root42802228 materializes only the active PostgreSQL snapshot value once for the five background snapshot call sites. Full canonical fields, ledger/catalogue/relation/full-row fingerprints, complete maps, literal ordering, volatile transaction status and actual clocks remain equivalent by complete AST substitution. The canonical SQL text/hash changes; both native B programmes/inputs, verification SQL, setup authority, reader/metadata diagnostics, result/WeakMap/control code and all45/70/120/180 limits remain exact. Performance and the R2 cancelled statement are unproved. Root must mount the complete reviewed shared-helper plus current adapter source-pin companion and commit before the existing saved/index/HEAD guards can admit any retry. Older frozen packets remain unchanged and need their own reviewed source binding if reused.
